zsign upstream source
=====================

Repository: https://github.com/zhlynn/zsign
Vendored commit: fe1750d (archo.cpp / signing.cpp only, over base 28a64217)
Commit date: 2026-04-19
License: MIT, see LICENSE in this directory.

Signature-correctness updates applied over the 28a64217 base:
- a98b1ce "produce signatures that pass macOS codesign --verify"
  (CS_EXECSEG_MAIN_BINARY always set on the main executable; ALLOW_UNSIGNED
  only when get-task-allow is actually <true/>; CMS cdhashes only for CDs
  that exist).
- fe1750d "emit DER entitlements in Apple canonical form, default SHA256-only"
  (fixes DER bool 0xFF, dict tag 0xb0, [0x70]{version,dict} wrapper).
Only archo.cpp and signing.cpp changed between the two commits within the
vendored subset; zsign.cpp is the excluded CLI. The bridge
(Core/Resigning/ZSign/ZSignBridge.mm) now initialises ZSignAsset with
bSHA256Only=true to match the modern-Mac default.

Included:
- src signing library sources used by EasySign.
- src/common helpers.
- src/third-party/minizip, excluding Windows-only iowin32 files.
- src/third-party/zlib.

Excluded:
- src/zsign.cpp, because EasySign embeds zsign as an in-process backend instead of building the CLI main.
- certcheck and metadata CLI helpers, because the app signing flow does not use them.
- upstream build scripts and prebuilt third-party binaries.
